newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firm, supply tight but buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firm, supply tight but buyers scarce.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was firm on Wednesday but the market was relatively quiet, traders said.
There was talk a cargo had traded at Oct +$35, cif NWE, but some trader said this sounded rather low.
Barge premiums were put at Sept IPE +$19/+$20, but market activity was minimal.
"Avails are still pretty tight but buyers are also pretty scarce," one trader said.
Premiums in the Mediterranean were softer as the supply situation eased. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
